title: Tenant Attestation Coordinator: SCIM/SAML/RBAC Evidence Bundler
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a coordinated attestation orchestration service that periodically generates tenant-scoped access evidence for RBAC, SSO (SAML) sessions, and SCIM provisioning events. The service must: 1) reconcile SCIM deltas against current role assignments, 2) surface SSO session anomalies tied to residency zones, 3) assemble a signed evidence bundle (manifest + attachments) stored in the customer residency location, and 4) drive reviewer workflows in Console and via email/Slack. This addresses auditability and long-term retention requirements for regulated customers and enables automated exports into the compliance evidence pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler can create per-tenant attestation tasks scoped by residency tag
SCIM delta listener produces reconciliation items with a reproducible diff format
SAML session exports correlated with last-login and residency metadata
Evidence bundler assembles manifest.json, candidate CSVs, signer metadata, and uploads to tenant residency bucket
Signed manifest KMS signature verified by evidence ingestion pipeline
Reviewer UI in Console shows queue, allows sign-off and reassign, and records reviewer audit trail
Automated email/Slack reminders configurable per-tenant cadence
End-to-end test and smoke checks with synthetic tenant available in staging
design_notes: Use existing SCIM webhook stream; introduce idempotent reconciliation job to avoid double-counting
Attestation manifest schema will include residency_zone, retention_policy_id, snapshot_timestamp, and hashes for each artifact
Prefer server-side encryption with customer-managed keys (CMK) when tenant requests private deployment
Evidence bundle format targets a compressed ZIP with top-level manifest.json and signatures
Retention pointers written as metadata on the object rather than embedding full policy text to simplify downstream retention enforcement
implementation_plan: Phase 1: SCIM delta adapter + lightweight reconciliation worker (2 sprints)
Phase 2: Attestation scheduler, manifest generator, and KMS signing integration (2 sprints)
Phase 3: Console reviewer UX + notifications + evidence archival to residency bucket (1 sprint)
Phase 4: Rollout, telemetry, and e2e tests (1 sprint)

tradeoffs_and_decisions: Decision: Evidence bundles will be immutable objects stored per-tenant to simplify audits; tradeoff is additional storage cost vs simpler verification
Tradeoff: We considered streaming evidence directly into the compliance pipeline, but chose bundles so reviewers can inspect before export
Decision: Use service-driven reminders rather than external schedulers to maintain visibility in Console
Tradeoff: Keeping full diffs in bundles increases size; we will store trimmed diffs and include a delta-apply script for forensic reconstruction
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: SCIM event storms could overwhelm reconciliation workers — Mitigation: circuit-breaker + backpressure + checkpointing
Risk: KMS access latency impacting attestation completion SLOs — Mitigation: local signing cache for non-critical attestations; fallback to asynchronous signing
Risk: Cross-region residency restrictions — Mitigation: ensure evidence writer respects residency_zone and uses cloud-region-specific storage APIs
review_feedback: PM (Sofia Reyes): prioritize tenant-scoped retention pointers so legal can map retention to residency quicker
Security (Jordan Mills): require KMS signing on all production bundles; add attestations for key rotation timeline
Design (Hiro Tanaka): reviewer UI should allow bulk accept/reject with justification templates
Eng (Priya Nair): request additional metrics: time-to-sign, bundle-size, and signer latency
